follow_up.span: We evaluated 17,160 patients, including 10,186 without atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, who were followed for a median of 4.2 years.

absent_reason.analysis_set: No held source explicitly identifies the analysis population for the overall hospitalization-for-heart-failure estimate as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, or all randomized.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled patients with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease or risk; its population included participants with and without baseline heart failure. The served ITT designation remains unverified.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Of 17 160 patients, 671 (3.9%) had HFrEF, 1316 (7.7%) had HF without known reduced EF, and 15 173 (88.4%) had no history of HF at baseline.

notes: The served HR and CI match the primary-report abstract's separate heart-failure hospitalization result. The held full text describes trial entry criteria but reports a kidney biomarker substudy, not this endpoint estimate; fulltext_verified provenance is therefore unsupported for this estimate. Treatment dose and comparator are bound from the registry, which also states standard-of-care background therapy in both arms. Follow-up is the reported median.
